One of India's biggest international highway projects is now in its final stages. Around 89% of the work on the new four-lane Gorakhpur-Sonauli National Highway (NH-24) has already been completed. Once it opens, it will make travelling to Nepal much easier for people coming from Delhi, Uttar Pradesh and Bihar.

For travellers from Delhi-NCR, the biggest highlight is the possibility of reaching Nepal in around eight hours, thanks to improved expressway and highway connectivity.

Also Read: This Is The First City In The UK Charging Tourists An Extra 5% To Stay Overnight

The Massive Project Connecting India And Nepal Is Almost Ready

Photo: Pexels

India has been building highways at a rapid pace, and this one is especially important because it connects two countries. The new highway runs from Gorakhpur to Sonauli, one of the busiest border crossings between India and Nepal. Every day, thousands of tourists, pilgrims, traders, buses and trucks use this route to cross into Nepal.

Until now, the journey has not been easy. The old road is only two lanes wide and passes through busy towns and markets. Long traffic jams, slow-moving trucks and bottlenecks are common, especially during holidays and festival seasons. That is exactly what this project aims to fix.

The old two-lane road is being transformed into a 79.5-km modern four-lane highway that is built for faster and safer travel. According to the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI), nearly 89% of the construction work is already complete, bringing the project much closer to opening. The road has also been designed so it can be expanded to six lanes in the future if traffic increases.

Also Read: Ahead Of Onam Rush, Bengaluru-Ernakulam Vande Bharat Doubles Seating Capacity

The Biggest Benefit Is Less Time On The Road

If you've travelled towards Nepal before, you probably know that the stretch between Gorakhpur and Sonauli can be frustrating. Once the new highway opens, that travel time is expected to come down significantly. For people travelling from Delhi, Noida, Ghaziabad, Lucknow or different parts of Bihar, it means a much faster journey to the Nepal border.

The project has been built with several modern features that will make driving easier and safer. The new corridor includes a railway bridge, two flyovers, 24 underpasses, 105 culverts, and around 68 km of service roads. On top of that, it will also have an Advanced Traffic Management System (ATMS). That means CCTV cameras will monitor traffic, electronic message boards will provide updates, emergency call boxes will help people in distress and real-time traffic monitoring will improve road safety.

With nearly 89% of the construction already completed, the Gorakhpur-Sonauli highway is now entering its final phase.

title: Third Meeting of the Nepal-Australia Bilateral Consultation Mechanism (BCM) - Ministry of Foreign Affairs Nepal
description: Third Meeting of the Nepal-Australia Bilateral Consultation Mechanism (BCM)  Ministry of Foreign Affairs Nepal
publisher.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs Nepal
full_article:
Press Release

The Third Meeting of the Nepal-Australia Bilateral Consultation Mechanism (BCM) concluded in Kathmandu today.

The two sides reviewed the entire gamut of Nepal-Australia bilateral relations and deliberated on matters of mutual interests. Both sides also reaffirmed their commitment to translating the understandings reached between the two sides into tangible outcomes for the mutual benefit of both countries.

The discussions during the BCM focused on deepening cooperation, focusing on priorities such as high-level political engagement, climate resilience, green economy, water resource management, agricultural research, and the alignment of Australia's Development Partnership Plan in line with Nepal's national priorities. Expansion of trade, air connectivity, tourism, investment in Nepal's hydropower sector and the establishment of a formal educational cooperation framework for education and research were also discussed. The meeting also focused on strengthening people-to-people links by leveraging diaspora networks, managing migration and visa frameworks and exploring sister-city relations.

They further exchanged views on regional and international trends, human rights, carbon trading frameworks and reciprocal support for candidacies in multilateral forums like the United Nations.

The meeting was co-chaired by Mr Amrit Bahadur Rai, Foreign Secretary of the Ministry and H. E. Ms Sarah Storey, First Assistant Secretary of the South and Central Asia Division at the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) of Australia.

Similarly, the first meeting of Joint Nepal-Australia Trade and Investment Committee under the Nepal Australia Trade and Investment Framework Arrangement (TIFA) was held in Kathmandu, yesterday.

The Australian delegation included Mr Simon Ernst, Ambassador of Australia to Nepal; Mr Steven Biddle, Regional Director for South Asia at the Department of Home Affairs; Army Adviser/Brigadier Damian Hill, Head of Australian Defence Staff; Mr George Thiveos, Minister-Counsellor (Education and Research) at the Australian High Commission in India; Mr Greg Klemm, Deputy Head of Mission at the Australian Embassy in Kathmandu; Mr Dylan Jones-Virma, First Secretary Development at the Australian Embassy; and Ms Margot Holt, Policy Officer (DFAT).

The Nepali side consisted of Mr Prakash Adhikari, Joint Secretary and Head of the South-East Asia and the Pacific Division from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs; Mr Jeebachh Mandal, Joint Secretary, Water and Energy Commission Secretariat; Mr Dhani Ram Sharma, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Finance; Dr Hari Bahadur KC and Dr Rajendra KC, Joint Secretaries from the Ministry of Agriculture, Forests and Environment; Mr Buddha Bahadur Gurung, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Supplies; Mr Ananda Kafle, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Home Affairs; Mr Shiva Kumar Sapkota, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Education and Sports; Mr Narayan Prasad Wagle and Mr Binod Mukhiya, Under Secretaries and Mr Hemant Timilsina, Section Officer from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

The Bilateral Consultation Mechanism between Nepal and Australia was established in July 2017. The first and second meeting of the Mechanism were held in Kathmandu and Canberra in 2018 and 2022 respectively.

Ministry of Foreign Affairs

Singhadurbar, Kathmandu

नेपाल-ऑस्ट्रेलिया द्विपक्षीय परामर्श तंत्र (बीसीएम)के तेसर बैसार आइ काठमाण्डौमे सम्पन्न भेल अछि ।

दुनू पक्ष नेपाल-ऑस्ट्रेलिया द्विपक्षीय सम्बन्धक सम्पूर्ण सरगमक समीक्षा केलक आ आपसी हितक विषयमे विचार-विमर्श केलक । दुनू पक्ष दुनू पक्षक बीच भेल समझौता केँ मूर्त परिणाम मे बदलबाक प्रतिबद्धता केँ सेहो दोबारा पुष्टि केलक जाहि सँ दुनू देशक आपसी लाभ होयत।

बीसीएम के दौरान भेल चर्चा सहयोग के गहरा करय पर केंद्रित छल, जाहि में उच्च स्तरीय राजनीतिक जुड़ाव, जलवायु लचीलापन, हरित अर्थव्यवस्था, जल संसाधन प्रबंधन, कृषि अनुसंधान, आ नेपाल के राष्ट्रीय प्राथमिकता के अनुरूप ऑस्ट्रेलिया के विकास साझेदारी योजना के संरेखण जेहन प्राथमिकता पर ध्यान देल गेल छल. व्यापार के विस्तार, हवाई संपर्क, पर्यटन, नेपाल के जलविद्युत क्षेत्र में निवेश आ शिक्षा आ शोध के लेल औपचारिक शैक्षणिक सहयोग के रूपरेखा के स्थापना पर सेहो चर्चा कायल गेल। बैठक म॑ प्रवासी नेटवर्क केरऽ लाभ उठाबै, प्रवास आरू वीजा केरऽ ढाँचा के प्रबंधन आरू बहिन-शहर संबंधऽ के खोज करी क॑ लोगऽ स॑ लोगऽ के संबंध क॑ मजबूत करै प॑ भी ध्यान देलऽ गेलै ।

आगू हुनका सब न॑ क्षेत्रीय आरू अंतर्राष्ट्रीय प्रवृत्ति, मानव अधिकार, कार्बन व्यापार केरऽ ढाँचा आरू संयुक्त राष्ट्र जैसनऽ बहुपक्षीय मंच प॑ उम्मीदवारी लेली पारस्परिक समर्थन प॑ विचार के आदान-प्रदान करलकै ।

बैठक केरऽ सह-अध्यक्षता मंत्रालय केरऽ विदेश सचिव श्री अमृत बहादुर राय आरू ऑस्ट्रेलिया केरऽ विदेश आरू व्यापार विभाग (डीएफएटी) म॑ दक्षिण आरू मध्य एशिया प्रभाग केरऽ प्रथम सहायक सचिव एच. ई. सुश्री सारा स्टोरी न॑ करलकै ।

तहिना नेपाल आस्ट्रेलिया व्यापार तथा निवेश ढाँचा व्यवस्था अन्तर्गत नेपाल आस्ट्रेलिया व्यापार तथा निवेश समितिके पहिल बैसार काठमाण्डौमे, काल्हि सम्पन्न भेल अछि ।

ऑस्ट्रेलिया के प्रतिनिधिमंडल में नेपाल में ऑस्ट्रेलिया के राजदूत श्री सिमोन अर्नस्ट; गृह विभाग के दक्षिण एशिया के क्षेत्रीय निदेशक श्री स्टीवन बिडल; सेना सलाहकार/ब्रिगेडियर डेमियन हिल, ऑस्ट्रेलियाई रक्षा स्टाफ के प्रमुख; भारत मे ऑस्ट्रेलियाई उच्चायोग मे मंत्री-परामर्शदाता (शिक्षा आ अनुसंधान) श्री जॉर्ज थिवेओस; काठमांडू मे ऑस्ट्रेलियाई दूतावास मे मिशन के उप प्रमुख श्री ग्रेग क्लेम; ऑस्ट्रेलियाई दूतावास के प्रथम सचिव विकास श्री डायलन जोन्स-विर्मा; आ सुश्री मार्गोट होल्ट, नीति अधिकारी (डीएफएटी)।

नेपाली पक्षमे विदेश मन्त्रालयसँ दक्षिण पूर्व एशिया आ प्रशांत प्रभागक संयुक्त सचिव आ प्रमुख श्री प्रकाश अधिकारी; श्री जीबछ मंडल, संयुक्त सचिव, जल एवं ऊर्जा आयोग सचिवालय, प्रो. वित्त मंत्रालय के संयुक्त सचिव श्री धनी राम शर्मा, प्रो. कृषि, वन एवं पर्यावरण मंत्रालय के संयुक्त सचिव डॉ. हरि बहादुर केसी एवं डॉ. राजेन्द्र केसी; श्री बुद्ध बहादुर गुरुंग, संयुक्त सचिव, उद्योग, वाणिज्य एवं आपूर्ति मंत्रालय, प्रो. श्री आनंद काफ्ले, गृह मंत्रालय के संयुक्त सचिव, प्रो. श्री शिव कुमार सापकोटा, संयुक्त सचिव, शिक्षा एवं खेल मंत्रालय, प्रो. श्री नारायण प्रसाद वागले आरू श्री बिनोद मुखिया, अवर सचिव आरू श्री हेमंत तिमिलसिना, विदेश मंत्रालय स॑ अनुभाग अधिकारी ।

नेपाल आ ऑस्ट्रेलिया के बीच द्विपक्षीय परामर्श तंत्र के स्थापना जुलाई २०१७ मे भेल छल ।तन्त्र के पहिल आ दोसर बैसार क्रमशः २०१८ आ २०२२ मे काठमांडू आ कैनबरा मे भेल छल ।

title: Great expectations - Nepali Times
description: Great expectations  Nepali Times
publisher.title: Nepali Times
full_article:
The RSP swept the election four month ago, benefiting from widespread public disillusionment with the past 20 years of misrule and poor governance by the old parties.

That was a vote for a departure from the past. And there were great expectations. Expectations can be unrealistic, but they stem from the hope. Decades of political dysfunction cannot be solved in months, but there are now signs of impatience in the public.

There are many who want to give this government a chance to set things right, but its high-handedness is putting too many people off.

Prime Minister Balendra Shah's government and his advisers seem to be resorting to distraction and deflection. Balendra Shah expected to win, but not with such a huge majority, so he is letting his advisers behave in the only way they know how — with tough talk, intimidation, and bypassing due process.

Instead of strengthening coordination and communication between line agencies, members of the PMO have been acting like a parallel government.

A widely-circulated investigation in setopati.com by editor Ameet Dhakal has meticulously detailed how the prime minister’s inner circle threatened officials, including the DG of the Passport Department Tirtha Raj Aryal and its IT director Sunil KC to cancel German e-passport deal. The CIAA chief Prem Kumar Rai was held hostage for hours in a PMO anteroom.

Also present were Foreign Secretary Amrit Rai and German Ambassador Udo Eugen Volz who were needlessly questioned and harassed for hours, Dhakal quoted sources as saying. Even when reminded that it would cost the country dearly, diplomatically and legally, they ordered proceedings against two German companies and 15 others.

Last year, the Nepal government awarded German companies Veridos GmbH and Mühlbauer ID Services a five-year contract worth Rs10.13 billion to arrange 6.4 million e-passports. The Department of Passports is alleged to have manipulated the procurement process to award the contract to the Germans.

The French company IDEMIA supplied Nepal’s machine-readable passports and e-passports until last year, losing the bid to Veridos GmbH and Mühlbauer ID Services after 17 years. IDEMIA challenged the decision in court but the Public Procurement Review Committee dismissed it. The French firm itself is alleged to have bypassed the Public Procurement Act through bribery, and the action against the Germans is seen as a retribution for losing the contract.

‘The way constitutional officials and state administrators were berated exceeding all constitutional bounds inside the Prime Minister's Office on 15 June over the passport procurement case is a troubling sign of a government run by a tight inner circle,” Dhakal later wrote in an editorial.

He continued: “By discarding established governance norms and democratic principles, the Prime Minister’s Secretariat operated like a shadow cabinet. Its chief qualification wasn't administrative competence, but the blind impulse of populism and an arrogant 'we know it all' mindset.”

The prime minister’s vocal supporters have applauded his move to thumb its nose at what they believe was a tainted deal by a previous government. They blame the messenger for exposing the bungling.

Bypassing the Foreign Ministry and acting without constitutional jurisdiction or formal expertise has harmed Nepal’s credibility in the international arena, and shown once again how feckless and fickle the PM’s advisers have been.

Evidence is growing that Balendra Shah and his kitchen cabinet are working to undermine the state mechanism, driven partly by their belief that two-thirds is mandate to uproot everything.

From the eviction of squatters to bungling international relations, Nepal is paying too high a price for signs of change that ordinary citizens have not yet seen. The last straw for many was the 3% equity tax on private healthcare and education. The prime minister appears to have read the writing on the wall and rolled it back (page 1).

The government had also proposed the Vehicle and Transport Management Bill, which introduced significantly harder penalties for traffic violations with fines up to Rs100,000, before the self-immolation of Ganesh Nepali after repeated traffic fines for illegal parking. To deflect scrutiny, supporters of the Balendra Shah government illegally parked their cars in front of select media houses, an act later condemned by their own party.

These recent cases show that one hand of government doesn’t know what the other hand is doing. Nearly four months into the RSP government, the cracks in the party’s formidable armour are beginning to show.

Everything came to a head this week with fresh rumours of the prime minister preparing to sack Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle over ideological and policy differences. Wagle’s equity tax was ill-advised in a country where those seeking private schools or hospitals are not necessarily the wealthy.

The Rabi-Swarnim chat at the Dustin Thani seems to have resolved the issue for now. It now remains to be seen how long party chair Rabi Lamichhane can keep doing damage control and keep the RSP together for the next five years. There are seemingly irreconcilable differences in personality and working style between the party and the PMO.

Feedback about international relations seems to be getting across to the prime minister who is finally meeting Indian and Chinese envoys separately later this week. He has also been holding consultations with the business sector.

The hope is that the PMO and the RSP will come together as they did during the election campaign and show greater accountability for their own good. Failure is not an option for the country, either.

जे अतीत स अलग हेबाक वोट छल। आ बहुत पैघ उम्मीद सेहो छल। अपेक्षा अवास्तविक भ सकैत अछि, मुदा ओ आशा स उपजल अछि। दशकों स राजनीतिक विकार महीनों मे नहि सुलझल जा सकैत अछि, मुदा आब जनता मे अधीरता क संकेत देखबा मे आबि रहल अछि।

बहुतो एहन छथिन्ह जे एहि सरकार के बात के ठीक करय के मौका देबय चाहय छथिन्ह मुदा एकर हाई-हैंडपन बेसि लोक के टालि रहल अछि.

प्रधानमंत्री बलेन्द्र शाह के सरकार आओर हुनकर सलाहकार विकर्षण आओर विक्षेप के सहारा ल रहल देखा रहल छथिन्ह. बलेन्द्र शाह क॑ जीत के उम्मीद छेलै, लेकिन एतना विशाल बहुमत के साथ नै, ई लेली वू अपनऽ सलाहकारऽ क॑ एकमात्र तरीका स॑ व्यवहार करै ल॑ द॑ रहलऽ छै जेकरा स॑ ओकरा पता छै — कठोर बात, धमकी, आरू उचित प्रक्रिया क॑ बाईपास करी क॑ ।

लाइन एजेंसी के बीच समन्वय आ संचार मजबूत करय के बजाय पीएमओ के सदस्य समानांतर सरकार के तरह काज करैत आबि रहल छथिन्ह.

संपादक अमीत ढकाल द्वारा setopati.com पर व्यापक रूप स॑ प्रसारित जांच म॑ बहुत सावधानी स॑ बतैलऽ गेलऽ छै कि कोना प्रधानमंत्री केरऽ भीतरी घेरा न॑ पासपोर्ट विभाग केरऽ डीजी तीर्थराज अर्यल आरू ओकरऽ आईटी निदेशक सुनील केसी सहित अधिकारियऽ क॑ जर्मन ई-पासपोर्ट सौदा रद्द करै के धमकी देलकै । सीआईएए के प्रमुख प्रेम कुमार राय के पीएमओ के एंटीरूम में घंटों बंधक बना क राखल गेल छल।

सूत्रऽ के हवाला स॑ ढकाल न॑ कहलकै कि विदेश सचिव अमृत राय आरू जर्मनी केरऽ राजदूत उडो यूजेन वोल्ज भी मौजूद छेलै जेकरा स॑ घंटों तलक बेवजह पूछताछ आरू परेशान करलऽ गेलै । जखन मोन पाड़ल गेल जे एहि स देश कए महग, कूटनीतिक आ कानूनी रूप स नुकसान होएत, तखनो ओ सब दूटा जर्मन कंपनी आ 15टा कंपनी क खिलाफ कार्रवाई क आदेश देलथि।

पिछला साल नेपाल सरकार जर्मन कंपनी वेरिडोस जीएमबीएच आ मुहलबाउर आईडी सर्विसेज कए 64 लाख ई-पासपोर्ट क व्यवस्था करबा लेल 10.13 अरब टका क पांच साल क ठेका देलक अछि। आरोप छै कि पासपोर्ट विभाग न॑ खरीद प्रक्रिया म॑ हेरफेर करी क॑ जर्मनी क॑ ई ठेका देल॑ छै ।

फ्रांस के कंपनी आईडीईएमआईए पिछला साल तक नेपाल के मशीन सं पढ़य योग्य पासपोर्ट आओर ई-पासपोर्ट के आपूर्ति केलक, जाहि सं 17 साल बाद वेरिडोस जीएमबीएच आओर मुहलबाउर आईडी सर्विसेज सं बोली हार गेल. आईडीईएमआईए एहि फैसला कए कोर्ट मे चुनौती देलक मुदा लोक खरीद समीक्षा समिति एकरा खारिज क देलक। आरोप छै कि फ्रांसीसी फर्म न॑ खुद घूसखोरी के माध्यम स॑ सार्वजनिक खरीद अधिनियम क॑ बाईपास करी देलकै, आरू जर्मनी के खिलाफ ई कार्रवाई क॑ अनुबंध हारला के बदला के रूप म॑ देखलऽ जाय छै ।

बाद मँ ढकल नँ एगो संपादकीय मँ लिखलकै, ‘पासपोर्ट खरीद के मामला मँ १५ जून क प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय के भीतर संवैधानिक अधिकारियौ आरू राज्य प्रशासकौ क सब संवैधानिक सीमा पार करी क जे तरह स॑ डांटलऽ गेलै, वू कड़ा भीतरी घेरा द्वारा संचालित सरकार के परेशान करै वाला संकेत छै ।

हुनी आगू कहलकै, “स्थापित शासन मानदंड आरू लोकतांत्रिक सिद्धांत क त्याग करी क प्रधानमंत्री सचिवालय छाया मंत्रिमंडल के तरह संचालित छेलै । एकरऽ मुख्य योग्यता प्रशासनिक योग्यता नै छेलै, बल्कि लोकवाद केरऽ आन्हर आवेग आरू अहंकारी ‘हमरा सब क॑ पता छै’ मानसिकता छेलै।”

प्रधानमंत्री केरऽ मुखर समर्थक न॑ हुनकऽ ई कदम प॑ तारीफ करलकै कि हुनी ई बात प॑ नाक ठूंसै के कोशिश करलकै जेकरा हुनकऽ मानना छै कि ई एगो पिछला सरकार केरऽ दागदार सौदा छेलै । बंगलिंग के उजागर करय लेल दूत के दोषी ठहराबैत छथिन्ह.

विदेश मंत्रालय क॑ बाईपास करी क॑ बिना संवैधानिक अधिकार क्षेत्र या औपचारिक विशेषज्ञता के काम करला स॑ अंतरराष्ट्रीय क्षेत्र म॑ नेपाल केरऽ विश्वसनीयता क॑ नुकसान पहुँचलऽ छै, आरू एक बार फेरू ई देखाबै छै कि पीएम केरऽ सलाहकार कतेक बेढंगा आरू चंचल रहलऽ छै ।

सबूत बढ़ी रहलऽ छै कि बलेन्द्र शाह आरू हुनकऽ किचन कैबिनेट राज्य केरऽ तंत्र क॑ कमजोर करै के काम करी रहलऽ छै, जेकरऽ कुछ हद तलक ई मान्यता स॑ प्रेरित छै कि दू तिहाई सब कुछ उखाड़ै के जनादेश छै ।

सुकून के बेदखली स ल कए अंतरराष्ट्रीय संबंध मे गडबड तक नेपाल परिवर्तन क संकेत क बहुत बेसी कीमत चुका रहल अछि जे आम नागरिक एखन धरि नहि देख सकल अछि। बहुतो के लेल अंतिम भूसा छल निजी स्वास्थ्य सेवा आ शिक्षा पर 3% इक्विटी टैक्स। प्रधानमंत्री देबाल पर लिखल लेख पढ़ि कए पाछू घुमा देने बुझाइत छथि (पृष्ठ 1)।

अवैध पार्किंग के लेल बेर-बेर यातायात जुर्माना के बाद गणेश नेपाली के आत्मदाह सं पहिने यातायात उल्लंघन के लेल काफी कठोर दंड लागू करय वाला वाहन आ परिवहन प्रबंधन विधेयक सेहो सरकार प्रस्तावित केने छल. जांच क॑ भटकाबै लेली बलेंद्र शाह सरकार केरऽ समर्थक न॑ गैरकानूनी तरीका स॑ अपनऽ गाड़ी क॑ चुनिंदा मीडिया हाउस के सामने खड़ा करी देलकै, जेकरऽ बाद म॑ ओकरऽ खुद के पार्टी न॑ एकरऽ निंदा करलकै ।

हाल के ई मामला बताबैत अछि जे सरकार के एक हाथ के पता नहिं छनि जे दोसर हाथ की क’ रहल अछि. आरएसपी सरकार के करीब चारि महीना बाद पार्टी के दुर्जेय कवच मे दरार देखय लेल मिलय लागल अछि.

वैचारिक आ नीतिगत मतभेद के ल क प्रधानमंत्री के वित्त मंत्री स्वर्णिम वागले के बर्खास्त करय के तैयारी के ताजा अफवाह के संग एहि सप्ताह सब किछु चरम पर आबि गेल. वैगले’क इक्विटी टैक्स ओहि देश मे खराब सलाह देल गेल छल जतय प्राइवेट स्कूल या अस्पताल’क तलाश करय वाला जरूरी नहिं जे ओ धनिक होथि.

डस्टिन थानी मे रबी-स्वर्णिम गपशप फिलहाल एहि मुद्दा कए सुलझि गेल बुझाइत अछि। आब देखबाक अछि जे पार्टीक अध्यक्ष रबी लामिछाने कतेक दिन धरि नुकसान नियंत्रण करैत रहि सकैत छथि आ अगिला पांच साल धरि आरएसपी केँ एक संग राखि सकैत छथि। पार्टी आ पीएमओ मे व्यक्तित्व आ कार्यशैली मे असमंजस प्रतीत होइत अछि ।

अंतरराष्ट्रीय संबंधऽ के बारे म॑ प्रतिक्रिया प्रधानमंत्री तलक पहुँची रहलऽ नजर आबी रहलऽ छै जे आखिरकार ई सप्ताह के अंत म॑ भारतीय आरू चीनी दूतऽ स॑ अलग-अलग मुलाकात करी रहलऽ छै । ओ व्यवसायिक क्षेत्र स सेहो परामर्श दैत आबि रहल छथि।

आशा अछि जे पीएमओ आओर आरएसपी जेना चुनाव प्रचार के दौरान एक संग आबि अपन भलाई के लेल बेसि जवाबदेही देखाओत. असफलता सेहो देश लेल कोनो विकल्प नहि अछि।

full_article:
KATHMANDU: Inspector General of Police (IGP) Dan Bahadur Karki has said that the open border, illegal entry of foreign nationals and limited legal jurisdiction have emerged as major challenges for border security.

Addressing a meeting of the Federalism Strengthening and National Concerns Committee at Singha Durbar on Friday, IGP Karki briefed lawmakers about the challenges faced by Nepal Police in maintaining border security and controlling cross-border crimes.

According to Karki, the number of Rohingya, Pakistani and Somali nationals entering Nepal illegally through India has increased in recent times. He said some individuals from these groups, who have settled in different parts of Nepal, have been found involved in activities with security implications, including drug trafficking.

“The issue of Rohingya refugees has also emerged as a challenge in terms of border security. Those who enter Nepal from India and attempt to settle in different places are being identified, monitored and handed over to the concerned authorities. Some of them have been found involved in crimes such as drug trafficking,” Karki said.

He informed the committee that police have also been coordinating with Indian authorities regarding Nepali citizens detained by Indian police on allegations of fertilizer smuggling along the southern border. He said police-to-police coordination and diplomatic initiatives are underway and the detainees are expected to be released after completion of legal procedures.

Highlighting legal challenges, Karki said investigations into certain cross-border crimes have become difficult due to the absence of provisions allowing Nepal to exercise extraterritorial jurisdiction.

“Recently, necessary steps have been taken through police coordination and diplomatic efforts regarding Nepali citizens arrested in a fertilizer-related smuggling case along the southern border. Since Nepal’s laws do not provide extraterritorial jurisdiction for some cross-border crimes, investigation and legal action become difficult,” he said.

Karki said illegal arms trafficking, drug smuggling, transnational organized crime, cyber fraud, online scams, human trafficking, illegal foreign employment networks, banking fraud and online betting are among the major security challenges linked to open borders.

He said many citizens have lost billions of rupees due to fraud schemes, particularly those involving promises of foreign employment and banking scams conducted through one-time passwords (OTPs).

“To address these challenges, Nepal Police has been strengthening border security through regular patrols, surveillance and joint security operations, along with the use of technologies such as drones, scanners and trained K-9 units,” Karki said.

काठमाण्डु : पुलिस महानिरीक्षक दान बहादुर कार्की खुला सीमा, विदेशी नागरिक के अवैध प्रवेश आ सीमित कानूनी अधिकार क्षेत्र सीमा सुरक्षा के लेल पैघ चुनौती के रूप में सामने आयल बतौलनि अछि।

शुक्रदिन सिंहदरबारमे संघीयता सुदृढीकरण आ राष्ट्रिय सरोकार समितिके बैसारके सम्बोधन करैत आईजीपी कार्की सीमा सुरक्षा निर्वाह आ सीमा पारसँ अपराध नियन्त्रणमे नेपाल प्रहरीके सोझा रहल चुनौतीके बारेमे विधायकसबके जानकारी देलन्हि ।

कार्की के अनुसार हाल के समय में भारत के माध्यम स अवैध तरीका स नेपाल में प्रवेश करय वाला रोहिंग्या, पाकिस्तानी आ सोमाली नागरिक के संख्या बढ़ल अछि। ओ कहलनि जे, नेपाल के विभिन्न भाग मे बसल एहि समूह के किछु व्यक्ति नशा के तस्करी सहित सुरक्षा प्रभाव वाला गतिविधि मे शामिल पाओल गेल अछि।

कार्की कहलनि जे, सीमा सुरक्षा के मामला मे सेहो रोहिंग्या शरणार्थी के मुद्दा चुनौती के रूप मे सामने आयल अछि, भारत सं नेपाल मे प्रवेश करय वाला आ अलग-अलग जगह पर बसय के कोशिश करय वाला के पहचान क निगरानी आ संबंधित अधिकारी के सौंपल जा रहल अछि, ओहि मे सं किछ लोक के नशा तस्करी जेहन अपराध मे शामिल पाओल गेल अछि.

दक्षिणी सीमा पर खाद तस्करी के आरोप मे भारतीय पुलिस द्वारा हिरासत मे लेल गेल नेपाली नागरिक के संबंध मे सेहो पुलिस भारतीय अधिकारी के संग समन्वय करैत आबि रहल समिति के जानकारी देलनि। ओ कहलनि जे, पुलिस-पुलिस समन्वय आ कूटनीतिक पहल चलि रहल अछि आ कानूनी प्रक्रिया पूरा भेला पर हिरासत मे लेल गेल लोक के रिहा करबाक उम्मीद अछि।

कानूनी चुनौती पर प्रकाश दैत कार्की कहलनि जे, नेपाल के बाह्यक्षेत्रीय अधिकार क्षेत्र के प्रयोग करय के अनुमति देबय वाला प्रावधान के अभाव के कारण सीमा पार के किछ अपराध के जांच मुश्किल भ गेल अछि.

ओ कहलनि जे, हाल मे दक्षिणी सीमा पर खाद सं जुड़ल तस्करी के मामला मे गिरफ्तार नेपाली नागरिक के संबंध मे पुलिस समन्वय आ कूटनीतिक प्रयास के माध्यम सं आवश्यक कदम उठाओल गेल अछि, नेपाल के कानून मे सीमा पार के किछु अपराध के लेल बाह्य क्षेत्राधिकार नहि देल गेल अछि, ताहि लेल जांच आ कानूनी कार्रवाई मुश्किल भ जाइत अछि।

title: PM Shah vows govt. support for market expansion for Nepali business community - The Rising Nepal

full_article:
Kathmandu, July 24: Prime Minister Balendra Shah has said the government is committed to addressing the demands raised by industrialists and business people to expand the market for Nepali products internationally.

During a meeting with representatives of the Nepal Plywood Manufacturers' Association, Nepal Carpet Manufacturers and Exporters' Association, Nepal Pashmina Industries Association and Nepal Dog Chew Manufacturers Association on Friday, the PM said the government was ready to facilitate the business community and address its concerns.

On the occasion, Chairperson of the Nepal Carpet Manufacturers and Exporters' Association, Balaram Gurung, said the carpet manufacturing and export sector has suffered under new laws in the United States, a key market for Nepali carpets along with European countries.

Gurung said a mandatory US Consumer Product Safety Commission verification requirement, which came into effect from July 8, has halted Nepal's exports, as Nepal lacks the facility to meet it. He sought government assistance in securing a year-long grace period before the next provision takes effect.

Gurung also requested that the Foreign Ministry send a diplomatic note to the US Customs Department seeking the grace period, and PM Shah immediately directed the ministry to do so.

Gurung further urged the PM to ensure timely quarantine certification of raw materials imported for carpet production, noting that businesspeople have been affected by having to obtain wool certification three times a month. PM Shah directed the concerned bodies to reduce this to twice a week.

The PM's Secretariat stated that PM Shah has taken positively to the demand for the constitution of the Carpet Development Board.

Likewise, PM Shah said the government will play role to promote sheep rearing in Karnali and Sudurpaschim provinces for the production of mutton and wool.

On the occasion, Chairperson of Nepal Plywood Manufacturers' Association Hom Prasad Ghimire said that some legal hassles have created more challenges to this business despite Nepal's higher quality in plywood compared to the products imported from other countries.

He said veneer (raw materials for plywood) is being exported to India in a very low customs rate despite Nepal's massive investment in plywood factories.

On Ghimire's concerns, PM Shah said the government was working to discourage import of raw materials of plywood by increasing the export tariffs.

Chairperson of the Nepal Pashmina Industries Association, Dhan Prasad Lamichhane, called for wool and silk collection to be ensured at the local level, with processing centers established at the provincial level. PM Shah agreed to facilitate this as well.

Chairperson of the Nepal Dog Chew Manufacturers Association, Resham Bahadur Pokhrel, said legal bottlenecks have prevented manufacturers from producing and exporting dog chews. He asked that dog chews be reclassified as pet food rather than dairy products, and that imports of skimmed milk powder for manufacturers be facilitated. PM Shah said the government would study the issue and address it if appropriate. (RSS)

title: Nepal Deports 287 Foreign Nationals in Seven Months, Including Americans, as Penalty Revenue Falls - nepyork

full_article:
Nepal deported 287 foreign nationals in the first seven months of 2026, including 219 who had overstayed their visas and 68 convicted in serious criminal and legal cases, according to the Department of Immigration.

The figures, covering Jan. 1 to July 22, suggest a growing challenge for Nepal’s immigration system as the country faces a steady rise in illegal stays and foreign nationals involved in criminal activity. The number of people deported on legal and criminal grounds in just over six months already exceeds the full-year total of several previous years.

Deportations on the Rise

From 2021 through 2025, Nepal deported 2,270 foreign nationals, including 2,049 overstayers and 221 people removed for criminal or other legal violations, department data show.

The annual total stood at 218 in 2021, when travel was still restricted due to the pandemic. That number rose to 570 in 2022, 458 in 2023, 501 in 2024, and 523 in 2025.

Officials say the trend reflects both a rise in visa overstays and a growing number of foreign nationals linked to cyber fraud, financial crimes, illegal business activity, and other offenses.

An immigration officer works at the Department of Immigration in Kathmandu, Nepal. (Dipendra Dhungana for NepYork)

Criminal Cases Climbing

The number of foreign nationals deported after being convicted or involved in legal cases has increased every year over the past five years.

In 2021, 25 people were deported on criminal or legal grounds. That number rose to 36 in 2022, 46 in 2023, 50 in 2024, and 64 in 2025. By July 22 of this year, that figure had already reached 68.

Authorities say the increase points to a deeper security concern, with foreign nationals becoming increasingly active in illegal activities such as online scams, financial fraud, cryptocurrency-related offenses, and organized crime.

Chinese Nationals Top the List

Chinese nationals accounted for the largest share of deportations in recent years, according to the data.

In 2021, 34 Chinese nationals were deported. The number surged to 191 in 2022, before reaching 209 in 2023. In 2024, 141 Chinese nationals were deported, followed by 120 in 2025.

Authorities say many of these cases involved online cyber fraud, illegal call centers, cryptocurrency dealings, unlawful networking schemes, and gold smuggling.

Bangladeshi nationals have also appeared in increasing numbers. Nepal deported 19 Bangladeshi nationals in 2023, 51 in 2024, and 75 in 2025. Officials say some entered Nepal on tourist visas and later joined human trafficking networks linked to third-country travel, while others simply remained in the country after their visas expired.

U.S. Passport. Photo by Global Residence Index

American and British nationals have also been deported in notable numbers. In 2025, Nepal deported 35 Americans and 22 Britons, according to the data. Officials say some Western nationals were found working without authorization, engaging in religious proselytizing, or overstaying visas under the cover of non-governmental, spiritual, or tourist activity.

Penalty Revenue Falls

Despite the rise in deportations, revenue from immigration penalties has fallen steadily over the past six fiscal years.

Under the revenue heading “administrative penalties and confiscation,” the Department of Immigration collected a total of 138.38 million rupees over the period, according to official figures.

The department collected 33.88 million rupees in fiscal year 2019–20, 24.92 million rupees in 2020–21, 20.77 million rupees in 2021–22, and 26.31 million rupees in 2022–23. Revenue then fell to 18.11 million rupees in 2023–24 and 14.37 million rupees in 2024–25.

That represents a penalty revenue drop of roughly 57.6% compared to 2019–20, even as deportations remained steadily in the 400 to 500 range each year. Officials attribute the decline to waivers granted on humanitarian grounds and a shift toward sending convicted foreign nationals directly to prison and then deporting them, rather than relying primarily on fines.

The department has projected 28.25 million rupees in penalty revenue for fiscal year 2025–26, signaling a potentially tougher crackdown on overstayers and unauthorized foreign workers.

Where the Money Goes

Immigration officials emphasize that money collected from visa fees, trekking permits, and administrative penalties does not remain with the department or individual field offices.

By law, funds are deposited directly into Nepal’s federal consolidated fund through the Nepal Rastra Bank. The money is subsequently allocated through the annual budget approved by parliament.

Authorities note that this revenue supports border security, immigration technology upgrades, digital visa systems, and staff training, alongside the direct costs of investigating, detaining, and deporting foreign nationals. It also contributes to broader public spending on infrastructure, public services, health, education, and administration.

Weak Monitoring and Open Borders

Immigration officials and security analysts link the rise in overstays and illegal activity to Nepal’s lenient visa system, weak monitoring capacity, and open border with India.

Nepal offers visas on arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport to citizens of most countries. While this policy supports tourism, officials acknowledge that it is frequently exploited by individuals with criminal intent.

Pedestrians and travelers cross through the security checkpoint at the Belahiya-Sunauli border crossing between Nepal and India in Rupandehi. Security personnel monitor the entry point near the Bhairahawa Customs Office as cross-border traffic and trade continue between the two nations. Photo: RSS

Foreign nationals entering on tourist visas have been caught secretly teaching, preaching, running unauthorized businesses, or leveraging information technology to execute financial scams. Bangladeshi and Pakistani nationals have also used Nepal as a transit hub to enter third countries or remained illegally after their visas expired.

Security Concerns Grow

Immigration control is widely regarded as a fundamental component of national security. However, officials acknowledge that Nepal still lacks a fully integrated central system to track where legally admitted foreign nationals reside and what activities they engage in.

While the government has improved tourist tracking systems over the past year, authorities stress that further measures are needed. The latest figures suggest that immigration administration must rely more heavily on tech-driven monitoring, joint inter-agency investigations, and stricter enforcement.

Officials recommend that the Department of Immigration and the Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) of the Nepal Police coordinate more closely to track down overstayers and dismantle illicit foreign-run operations. They also advise that the government revisit fine-waiver provisions and strictly enforce permanent blacklisting for foreign nationals convicted of illegal activity.

अधिकारियऽ के कहना छै कि ई रुझान वीजा केरऽ ओवरस्टे म॑ बढ़ोत्तरी आरू साइबर धोखाधड़ी, वित्तीय अपराध, अवैध व्यापारिक गतिविधि, आरू अन्य अपराधऽ स॑ जुड़लऽ विदेशी नागरिकऽ के बढ़तऽ संख्या दूनू क॑ दर्शाबै छै ।

एकटा आप्रवासन अधिकारी नेपालक काठमाण्डौमे आप्रवासन विभागमे काज करैत अछि । (नेपयोर्क के लिये दीपेन्द्र ढुंगाना)

आपराधिक प्रकरण चढ़ाई

पिछला पांच साल मे दोषी पाओल गेल या कानूनी मामला मे शामिल भेलाक बाद देश निकाला कैल गेल विदेशी नागरिक क संख्या मे हर साल बढ़ोतरी भेल अछि।

2021 मे 25 लोक कए आपराधिक या कानूनी आधार पर देश निकाला कैल गेल छल। ओ संख्या 2022 मे 36, 2023 मे 46, 2024 मे 50 आ 2025 मे 64 भ गेल।एहि साल 22 जुलाई तक इ आंकड़ा 68 भ गेल छल।

अधिकारियऽ के कहना छै कि ई बढ़ोत्तरी सुरक्षा केरऽ गहरा चिंता के तरफ इशारा करी रहलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ विदेशी नागरिक ऑनलाइन घोटाला, वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी, क्रिप्टोकरेंसी स॑ जुड़लऽ अपराध, आरू संगठित अपराध जैसनऽ गैरकानूनी गतिविधियऽ म॑ तेजी स॑ सक्रिय होय रहलऽ छै ।

चीनी नागरिक सूची मे शीर्ष पर अछि

आंकड़ा के अनुसार हाल के साल में देश निकाला के सबस बेसी हिस्सा चीनी नागरिक के अछि।

2021 मे 34 चीनी नागरिक कए देश निकाला कैल गेल छल। ई संख्या 2022 म॑ बढ़ी क॑ 191 होय गेलै, जेकरा बाद 2023 म॑ 209 होय गेलै ।2024 म॑ 141 चीनी नागरिक क॑ देश निकाला करी देलऽ गेलै, जेकरा बाद 2025 म॑ 120 नागरिक क॑ देश निकाला करी देलऽ गेलै ।

अधिकारियऽ के कहना छै कि ई मामला म॑ स॑ बहुत सारा मामला ऑनलाइन साइबर धोखाधड़ी, अवैध कॉल सेंटर, क्रिप्टोकरेंसी सौदा, गैरकानूनी नेटवर्किंग योजना, आरू सोना के तस्करी स॑ जुड़लऽ छेलै ।

बांग्लादेशी नागरिक सेहो बढ़ैत संख्या मे देखा रहल अछि। नेपाल 2023 मे 19, 2024 मे 51, आ 2025 मे 75 बांग्लादेशी नागरिक कए देश निकाला केलक अछि।अधिकारी क कहब अछि जे किछु गोटे पर्यटक वीजा पर नेपाल मे प्रवेश केलथि आ बाद मे तेसर देश क यात्रा स जुड़ल मानव तस्करी नेटवर्क मे शामिल भ गेलाह, जखन कि किछु गोटे वीजा समाप्त भेलाक बाद बस देश मे रहि गेलाह।

अमेरिकी पासपोर्ट। ग्लोबल रेजिडेंस इंडेक्स द्वारा फोटो

अमेरिकी आरू ब्रिटिश नागरिकऽ क॑ भी उल्लेखनीय संख्या म॑ देश निकाला करी देलऽ गेलऽ छै । 2025 मे नेपाल 35 अमेरिकी आ 22 ब्रिटिश के देश निकाला केने छल, आंकड़ा के अनुसार। अधिकारी सब के कहना छै कि कुछ पश्चिमी नागरिक गैर-सरकारी, आध्यात्मिक या पर्यटन गतिविधि के आड़ में बिना प्राधिकरण के काम करतें, धार्मिक धर्म परिवर्तन में संलग्न, या वीजा के अधिक समय तक रहना मिललै ।

जुर्माना राजस्व गिरैत अछि

देश निकाला बढ़ला के बावजूद पिछला छह वित्तीय वर्ष मे आप्रवासन जुर्माना सं आमदनी मे लगातार गिरावट आयल अछि.

आधिकारिक आंकड़ा के अनुसार, राजस्व शीर्षक “प्रशासनिक दंड आरू जब्त” के तहत आप्रवासन विभाग न॑ ई अवधि म॑ कुल १३.८३८ करोड़ रुपया के वसूली करलकै ।

विभाग वित्तीय वर्ष 2019-20 मे 3.38 करोड़ रुपया, 2020-21 मे 24.92 मिलियन रुपया, 2021-22 मे 20.77 मिलियन रुपया, आ 2022-23 मे 2.63.1 करोड़ रुपया वसूली केलक। एकर बाद राजस्व 2023-24 मे 1.81 करोड़ आ 2024-25 मे 1.43.7 करोड़ टका भ गेल।

जे 2019-20 के तुलना म॑ जुर्माना राजस्व म॑ लगभग 57.6% के गिरावट के प्रतिनिधित्व करै छै, यहाँ तलक कि हर साल देश निकाला लगातार 400 स॑ 500 के रेंज म॑ रहलऽ छै । अधिकारी सब ई गिरावट के कारण मानवीय आधार पर देलऽ गेलऽ माफी आरू दोषी विदेशी नागरिकऽ क॑ सीधा जेल भेजै आरू ओकरा बाद देश निकाला करै के तरफ बदलाव के कारण बतैलकै, नै कि मुख्य रूप स॑ जुर्माना प॑ भरोसा करलऽ जाय ।

विभाग न॑ वित्तीय वर्ष २०२५-२६ लेली २.८.२५ मिलियन रुपया के जुर्माना राजस्व के अनुमान लगैल॑ छै, जे अधिक समय स॑ रहै वाला आरू अनधिकृत विदेशी मजदूरऽ प॑ संभावित रूप स॑ कड़ा दबाव के संकेत देल॑ छै ।

पैसा कहाँ जाइत अछि

आप्रवासन अधिकारी एहि बात पर जोर दैत छथि जे वीजा फीस, ट्रेकिंग परमिट, आ प्रशासनिक जुर्माना सं एकत्रित पाइ विभाग या व्यक्तिगत फील्ड ऑफिस पर नहिं रहैत अछि.

कानून के अनुसार नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंक के माध्यम स सीधा नेपाल के संघीय समेकित कोष में धन जमा कयल जाइत अछि | एकरऽ बाद संसद द्वारा मंजूर वार्षिक बजट के माध्यम स॑ ई पैसा के आवंटन करलऽ जाय छै ।

अधिकारियक कें ध्यान छै कि इ राजस्व सीमा सुरक्षा, आप्रवासन प्रौद्योगिकी उन्नयन, डिजिटल वीजा प्रणाली, आ कर्मचारी प्रशिक्षण कें साथ-साथ विदेशी नागरिकक कें जांच, हिरासत, आ देश निकाला कें सीधा लागत कें समर्थन करय छै. इ बुनियादी ढाँचा, लोक सेवाक, स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा, आ प्रशासन पर व्यापक सार्वजनिक खर्च मे सेहो योगदान दैत छै.

कमजोर निगरानी आ खुला सीमा

आप्रवासन अधिकारी आरू सुरक्षा विश्लेषकऽ न॑ ओवरस्टे आरू अवैध गतिविधि म॑ बढ़ोत्तरी क॑ नेपाल केरऽ नम्र वीजा प्रणाली, कमजोर निगरानी क्षमता, आरू भारत के साथ खुला सीमा स॑ जोड़ै छै ।

नेपाल अधिकांश देशक नागरिकके त्रिभुवन अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय विमानस्थलमे पहुँचला पर वीजा प्रदान करैत अछि । ई नीति पर्यटन के समर्थन करै छै, लेकिन अधिकारी सब ई बात क॑ स्वीकार करै छै कि एकरऽ दोहन अक्सर आपराधिक मंशा वाला व्यक्ति द्वारा करलऽ जाय छै ।

रुपन्देहीमे नेपाल आ भारतक बीच बेलाहिया-सुनौली सीमा पारक सुरक्षा नाकासँ पैदल चलनिहार आ यात्री पार करैत छथि । सुरक्षाकर्मी भैरहवा सीमा शुल्क कार्यालय के पास प्रवेश बिंदु पर नजर रखैत अछि, कियाकि दुनू राष्ट्र के बीच सीमा पार यातायात आ व्यापार जारी अछि। फोटो : आर एस एस

पर्यटक वीजा पर प्रवेश करय वाला विदेशी नागरिक गुप्त रूप सं पढ़बैत, प्रचार करैत, अनधिकृत व्यवसाय चलाबैत, या सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी के लाभ उठाबैत वित्तीय घोटाला के निष्पादन करैत पकड़ल गेल अछि. बांग्लादेशी आरू पाकिस्तानी नागरिक न॑ भी नेपाल क॑ पारगमन केंद्र के रूप म॑ इस्तेमाल करी क॑ तेसरऽ देश म॑ प्रवेश करलकै या वीजा समाप्त होय के बाद गैरकानूनी तरीका स॑ रहलऽ छै ।

सुरक्षा सरोकार बढ़ैत अछि

आप्रवासन नियंत्रण क॑ व्यापक रूप स॑ राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा केरऽ एगो मौलिक घटक के रूप म॑ मानलऽ जाय छै । लेकिन अधिकारी सब स्वीकार करै छै कि नेपाल म॑ अखनी भी कानूनी रूप स॑ प्रवेशित विदेशी नागरिक कहाँ रहै छै आरू कोन गतिविधि म॑ शामिल छै, ई पता लगाबै लेली पूर्ण रूप स॑ एकीकृत केन्द्रीय प्रणाली के कमी छै ।

सरकार पिछला एक साल स पर्यटक ट्रैकिंग सिस्टम मे सुधार केलक अछि, मुदा अधिकारी एहि बात पर जोर दैत छथि जे आओर उपाय क जरूरत अछि। ताजा आंकड़ा बताबै छै कि आप्रवासन प्रशासन क॑ टेक संचालित निगरानी, ​​संयुक्त अंतर-एजेंसी जांच, आरू सख्त प्रवर्तन प॑ अधिक निर्भर रहना चाहियऽ ।

अधिकारीसभ अनुशंसा करैत अछि जे नेपाल प्रहरीके आप्रवासन विभाग आ केन्द्रीय अनुसन्धान ब्यूरो (सीआईबी)के अधिक निकटतासँ तालमेल बैसा कऽ बेसी समयमे रहनिहारके पता लगाबय आ अवैध विदेशीसञ्चालन संचालन भंग करय । हुनी ई भी सलाह दै छै कि सरकार जुर्माना माफी के प्रावधानऽ प॑ दोबारा देखै आरू गैरकानूनी गतिविधि के दोषी ठहराबै वाला विदेशी नागरिकऽ लेली स्थायी ब्लैकलिस्टिंग क॑ सख्ती स॑ लागू करै ।

title: 'Elephants in the Fog': After Cannes Win, Nepal's Queer Cinema Gets Boost - Foreign Policy
description: 'Elephants in the Fog': After Cannes Win, Nepal's Queer Cinema Gets Boost  Foreign Policy
publisher.title: Foreign Policy
full_article: Until last year, Pushpa Thing Lama worked at an LGBTQ advocacy organization in a small western Nepal town, her work known only to a handful of people in the queer community. Today, she is one of the stars of an award-winning film that has become a landmark for Nepalese cinema, and queer Nepalis, on a global stage. In May, Elephants in the Fog marked a first for the country’s film industry by winning the Un Certain Regard Jury Prize at the Cannes Film Festival. The award was not only a rare win for Nepali cinema but also a defining moment for the country’s growing queer cinema scene and the kinnar community, whose lives have long been pushed to the margins and are now being celebrated on one of the world’s most prominent cultural stages. “This is not just a movie, this is our life,” Lama, a transgender actor, told Foreign Policy . “It has many similarities with our struggles—the prejudice we face from our families and society and the negative perception toward our community. This film isn’t fiction but a reflection of our lives.” Kinnars and hijras are a traditionally third gender community in South Asia, though not all transgender, non-binary, and intersex people in the region identify as kinnar. In Nepal, some embrace “kinnar” as a cultural identity, while others prefer transgender or third gender. Kinnars have their roots in Hindu mythology—described in epics such as the Mahabharata and Ramayana —and are seen as celestial figures divinely associated with the arts and culture. They are traditionally invited to bless weddings and births, especially in India and Nepal’s southern regions bordering India, despite continuing to face widespread stigma and discrimination. Elephants in the Fog , too, showcases the ceremonial aspect of kinnar life, though the filmmakers say it focuses less on mysticism and more on personal emotions, something often missing from Nepali films that portray queer characters. The film is anchored around the bond between a matriarch and her adopted daughters—all played by transgender actors—tracing the tensions between relationships, responsibilities, desire, and duty often invisible to outsiders. (The kinnar community is traditionally tied to fictive kinship, where a senior member becomes a symbolic mother, creating a chosen family that provides care and support to those who are ostracized.) Abinash Bikram Shah, writer and director of Elephants in the Fog , said he was inspired to make the film after coming across videos of the kinnar community on TikTok during the COVID-19 lockdowns. Despite persistent transphobic comments and online trolling, the creators continued sharing their content, which he found “encouraging and courageous.” Further research led Shah to cast actors from within the community, which allowed them to help shape the script and take greater ownership of their story, which lends the film a deeper sense of authenticity. “They have brought their history, instincts, and collective resilience to the film,” Shah told Foreign Policy . “So, I wasn’t capturing acting on camera—it was capturing the truth. I don’t see this as a queer movie, but a movie with a family dynamic between a mother and her daughters.” Pooja, Sir (2024) A still from Pooja, Sir (2024). Aadi Films/Baasuri Films/Tannhauser Gate The portrayal of queer characters in Nepali cinema—even when depicted as openly gay or transgender—has historically fallen short of authenticity, often leaving the community misunderstood and misrepresented. Effeminate male characters or gender non-conforming men cross-dressing—especially in movies like the Ae Mero Hajur 2 and numerous TV series—have mostly been used for comic relief, reinforcing stereotypes and shaping distorted perceptions about the LGBTQ community. But a breakthrough came in 2013 with Soongava: Dance of the Orchids , which presented a lesbian love story and is regarded as Nepal’s first mainstream queer movie. Its release came just two years after Nepal made global headlines for hosting its first symbolic same-sex wedding—between two Americans—at a Hindu temple near the capital, Kathmandu. The country’s landmark 2007 Supreme Court ruling recognizing sexual and gender minorities as equal citizens helped the queer community become more vocal and visible across Nepal’s social and cultural landscape. Even before Soongava brought the issues to wider attention, Shah had already brought queer characters to the screen in critically acclaimed films such as Sarir (2011) and Highway (2012). South Asia Brief | Michael Kugelman Some say the results have been mixed. Pragyan Thapa Ghimire, founding editor of The Nepali Cinematheque, said that while Soongava is “patchy in its depth, integrity, and sensitivity in terms of its queer representation,” movies released since then have attempted more accurate and nuanced portrayals. He added that queerness is diverse and fluid, and “extremely little of that has been reflected in Nepali cinema up to now.” However, efforts have continued, with mainstream filmmakers increasingly emboldened to explore queer stories and characters, indicating a growing appetite for cinema that engages with diverse themes and representations. In 2023, Ek Bhagavad Ra Ek Geeta featured gender fluid and transgender characters, while Gunyo Cholo: The Dress , released in 2025, was the coming-of-age story of a transgender woman. Pooja, Sir introduced audiences to a lesbian police officer ini 2024. “ Ek Bhagavad Ra Ek Geeta and Gunyo Cholo are very clear and intentional exercises in bringing awareness and generating empathy around queer issues,” Thapa Ghimire told Foreign Policy . “ Pooja, Sir presents a less dramatic, more subtle take on queerness by showing a protagonist who is clearly queer but has a lot more to them than that. This kind of representation, which resists making a spectacle or a moral debate out of queerness, plays to constructing an important, normalizing affect around it.” But there are looming questions whether audiences are receptive to such movies, and if they can guarantee box-office returns. Thapa Ghimire is unsure about audience readiness but said that queer-themed films should nonetheless be encouraged and supported, as they have the potential to shift social perceptions over time. Shah added that when queer stories are told within mainstream commercial cinema, featuring well-known filmmakers and actors, they can help familiarize wider audiences with LGBTQ characters and the challenges they face, while also expanding their visibility. “But visibility without depth means nothing,” Shah said. “We shouldn’t just see them from the lens of sympathy and pity and characterize them in such roles, or should we reduce those characters into stereotypes. We should see them as individuals, we need to empathize with them and humanize them for the audiences to see and feel.” Pushpa Thing Lama at the 79th annual Cannes Film Festival at Palais des Festivals on May 20, 2026 Lama at the 79th annual Cannes Film Festival at the Palais des Festivals in Cannes, France, on May 20. Stephane Cardinale-Corbis/Getty Images Over the years, throngs of well-wishers have gathered outside Kathmandu’s airport to welcome home athletes, mountaineers, and other national heroes, draping them with marigold garlands and khata —the traditional Buddhist ceremonial scarves—to celebrate their achievements. But the Elephant in the Fog team received an unprecedented homecoming for filmmakers, as government ministers, alongside crowds, joined to celebrate the film’s historic accomplishment at the airport. Reflecting on the journey that led to that moment, Lama said that none of the film’s transgender cast members had expected such recognition after years of living on society’s margins. For many, the opportunity to showcase their talent and to find meaningful work had already exceeded their expectations. Despite equal rights being granted to LGBTQ citizens through various routes, discrimination still persists in Nepal. A 2023 UN Women report found that only a few people have been able to obtain a citizenship certificate that accurately reflects their gender identity and expression, and LGBTQ individuals struggle to access basic services, including healthcare, education, and employment. This is particularly acute for transgender women and those who identify as third gender, since they tend to be more visible than other sexual minorities. “In Nepal, there are shifts in perception, but there’s still a significant gap that needs to be closed,” said Madhurima Bhadra, an expert on gender equality, disability, and social inclusion. “Though there are many positive changes at the governance and policy levels, implementation and inclusion, especially with the intention of not leaving anyone behind, is yet to be achieved.” According to Lama, limited job opportunities remain one of the transgender community’s persistent struggles, adding that many are turned away from employment or discouraged from seeking it altogether, with employers preferring men or women. Most queer-themed movies have also only cast non-queer actors. But the success of Elephants in the Fog , Lama hopes, could create new avenues for more transgender artists and performers in the industry. “I completely support the push for more trans actors in general, [not just for] authenticity, but they often already have very limited options,” Thapa Ghimire said. “ Elephants in the Fog will be important and influential on the strength of its achievement at Cannes. With that being said, I can’t say exactly how and to what degree.” As the movie readies for its Nepali release in September and other international festival runs—including in the United States—it carries hope of a community. But for many actors like Lama, the spotlight is fleeting, and what comes after the applause and awards matters more. For them, the fog, in many ways, has yet to lift. “I don’t know what I’ll do after this,” Lama said. “I admire the filmmakers for their courage in making this movie and giving us an opportunity. But one film isn’t enough. We need more opportunities, and want to live with equal rights and dignity just like anyone else.”

चाहियऽ आरू ऐन्हऽ भूमिका म॑ हुनकऽ विशेषता नै देना चाहियऽ, या वू पात्रऽ क॑ रूढ़िवादिता म॑ घटाबै के चाही ।हमरा सब क॑ हुनका व्यक्तिगत रूप म॑ देखना चाहियऽ, हुनका सब स॑ सहानुभूति रखै के जरूरत छै आरू दर्शक क॑ देखै आरू महसूस करै लेली हुनका मानवीय बनाबै के जरूरत छै ।” पुष्पा थिंग लामा २० मई २०२६ क॑ पलेस डेस फेस्टिवल म॑ ७९ वीं वार्षिक कान फिल्म फेस्टिवल म॑ लामा २० मई क॑ फ्रांस केरऽ कान म॑ पैलेस डेस फेस्टिवल म॑ ७९ वीं वार्षिक कान फिल्म फेस्टिवल म॑ स्टीफन कार्डिनल-कोर्बिस/गेटी इमेजेज वर्षो स॑ काठमांडू केरऽ हवाई अड्डा के बाहर शुभचिंतकऽ के भीड़ घरऽ के एथलीट, पर्वतारोही, आरू अन्य राष्ट्रीय नायकऽ के स्वागत करै लेली जमा होय गेलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ हुनका सब क॑ मैरीगोल्ड के माला आरू खाटा —पारंपरिक बौद्ध अनुष्ठान केरऽ दुपट्टा — स॑ लपेटी क॑ हुनकऽ उपलब्धि के जश्न मनाबै के मौका मिललऽ छै । लेकिन एलिफेंट इन द फॉग टीम क॑ फिल्म निर्माता सिनी लेली एगो अभूतपूर्व घर वापसी मिललै, कैन्हेंकि भीड़ के साथ-साथ सरकारी मंत्री भी हवाई अड्डा प॑ फिल्म केरऽ ऐतिहासिक उपलब्धि के जश्न मनाबै लेली शामिल होय गेलै । ओहि क्षण केरऽ यात्रा प॑ चिंतन करतें हुअ॑ लामा न॑ कहलकै कि फिल्म केरऽ कोय भी ट्रांसजेंडर कलाकार क॑ समाज केरऽ हाशिया प॑ सालौ स॑ रहला के बाद ऐसनऽ पहचान के उम्मीद नै छेलै । बहुतो के लेलऽ अपनऽ प्रतिभा के प्रदर्शन आरू सार्थक काम खोजै के मौका पहिने स॑ ही हुनकऽ उम्मीद स॑ भी अधिक होय गेलऽ छेलै । विभिन्न मार्ग स एलजीबीटीक्यू नागरिक कए समान अधिकार देल गेलाक बादो नेपाल मे एखनो भेदभाव कायम अछि । 2023 केरऽ संयुक्त राष्ट्र महिला रिपोर्ट म॑ कहलऽ गेलऽ छै कि केवल कुछ लोग ही नागरिकता प्रमाणपत्र प्राप्त करै म॑ सफल रहलऽ छै जे ओकरऽ लैंगिक पहचान आरू अभिव्यक्ति क॑ सही ढंग स॑ दर्शाबै छै, आरू एलजीबीटीक्यू व्यक्ति स्वास्थ्य देखभाल, शिक्षा, आरू रोजगार सहित बुनियादी सेवा तलक पहुँचै लेली संघर्ष करै छै । इ विशेष रूप सं ट्रांसजेंडर महिलाआक आ जे लोग तेसर लिंग कें रूप मे पहचान करएयत छै, ओकरा लेल तीव्र छै, कियाकि इ अन्य यौन अल्पसंख्यक कें अपेक्षा बेसि दिखाई दै वाला होयत छै. लैंगिक समानता, विकलांगता, आ सामाजिक समावेश के विशेषज्ञ मधुरीमा भद्रा कहलनि जे, नेपाल मे धारणा मे बदलाव आबि रहल अछि, मुदा एखनो एकटा महत्वपूर्ण अंतर अछि जेकरा बंद करबाक जरूरत अछि। “शासन आरू नीति स्तर प॑ भले ही बहुत सकारात्मक परिवर्तन होय ​​रहलऽ छै, लेकिन खास करी क॑ ककरो पाछू नै छोड़ै के मंशा स॑ एकरऽ कार्यान्वयन आरू समावेश केरऽ काम अभी बाकी छै ।” लामा के अनुसार सीमित नौकरी के अवसर ट्रांसजेंडर समुदाय केरऽ लगातार संघर्ष म॑ स॑ एक बनलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ हुनी कहलकै कि बहुत लोगऽ क॑ रोजगार स॑ मुँह मोड़लऽ जाय छै या एकरा खोजै स॑ एकदम हतोत्साहित करलऽ जाय छै, जेकरा म॑ नियोक्ता पुरुष या महिला क॑ पसंद करै छै । अधिकांश क्वीयर थीम पर बनल सिनेमा मे सेहो केवल गैर-क्वीयर अभिनेता कए कास्ट कएल गेल अछि । लेकिन एलिफेंट इन द फॉग केरऽ सफलता स॑ लामा क॑ उम्मीद छै कि ई इंडस्ट्री म॑ अधिक ट्रांसजेंडर कलाकार आरू कलाकार लेली नया रास्ता पैदा होय सकै छै । थापा घिमिरे न॑ कहलकै कि हम्में सामान्य तौर प॑ अधिक ट्रांस अभिनेता केरऽ धक्का के पूरा समर्थन करै छियै, [केवल नै] प्रामाणिकता लेली, लेकिन ओकरा पास अक्सर पहल॑ स॑ ही बहुत सीमित विकल्प छै । “ कान मे अपन उपलब्धि’क ताकत पर कोहरा मे हाथी महत्वपूर्ण आ प्रभावशाली होयत. ई कहैत हम ठीक-ठीक नहि कहि सकैत छी जे कोना आ कोन डिग्री धरि.” जेना-जेना ई सिनेमा सितंबर म॑ अपनऽ नेपाली रिलीज के तैयारी करी रहलऽ छै आरू अन्य अंतर्राष्ट्रीय महोत्सव चलै छै-जेकरा म॑ अमेरिका भी शामिल छै-एक समुदाय के आशा ल॑ क॑ चलै छै । मुदा लामा सन कतेको अभिनेता लेल चर्चा क्षणिक होइत छैक, आ वाहवाही आ पुरस्कारक बाद की होइत छैक से बेसी मायने रखैत छैक । हुनका सब लेल कोहरा, बहुत तरह स, एखन धरि नहि उठल अछि। लामा बजलाह, “हमरा नहि बुझल अछि जे एकर बाद हम की करब।” "हम फिल्म निर्माता लोकनिक प्रशंसा करैत छी जे एहि सिनेमा केँ बनेबा मे आ हमरा सभ केँ मौका देबाक साहस केलनि. मुदा एकटा फिल्म पर्याप्त नहि अछि. हमरा सभ केँ बेसी अवसर चाही, आओर हम सभ केँ समान अधिकार आ गरिमा सँ जीबय चाहैत छी."
